author: reek
body: Browser front-end for The Bridge (voice command dashboard). Renders the BridgePage widget tree (shared UI components) through the common HTML widget runtime, and wires the admiral/captain controls to toggle voice state. The hierarchy is the same VoiceHierarchy the bare-metal app uses; per-node speaking/mute toggles are mirrored into flat render state so the dashboard reflects clicks without changing BridgePage.
